author: Khan Academy
description:
The net charge or charge distribution of a system can change in response to the presence of, or changes in, the net charge or charge distribution of other systems. Any change to a system’s net charge is due to a transfer of charge between the system and its surroundings. Grounding involves electrically connecting a charged object to a much larger and approximately neutral system (e.g., Earth).

Sections:
00:00 - Conservation of charge
02:00 - Insulators and static electricity
03:56 - Electric polarization and neutral objects
06:00 - Conductors and the electroscope
08:00 - Grounding excess charge
10:00 - Electrostatic induction
12:25 - Summary
